The '''''Bellator''-class dreadnought''', also known as the '''''Bellator''-class Star Destroyer''',<ref name="I134">[[Star Wars Insider 134|''Star Wars Insider'' 134]]</ref> was a divergent design in the [[Mandator-class Star Dreadnaught|''Mandator''-series]] of [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] that served as a [[Warship/Legends|warship]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]].

==Description==
===Dimensions===
[[File:ImperialFleetRefueling.jpg|thumb|left|160px|A ''Bellator''-class dreadnought during a fleet exercise, alongside two [[Allegiance-class battlecruiser|battlecruisers]], two [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], and another [[Assertor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|dreadnought]] being refueled by an [[Altor-class replenishment ship]].]]
The ''Bellator''-class was a model of dreadnought based on the earlier [[Mandator-class Star Dreadnaught|''Mandator''-]] and [[Mandator II-class Star Dreadnaught/Legends|''Mandator II''-class]] dreadnoughts. It was a scaled-down version, 800 meters shorter than its predecessors.

===Offensive and defensive systems===
The dorsal surface mounted a large array of gun batteries. The batteries were arranged both on the port and starboard sides of the hull, as well as on the ridge in front of the command tower.<ref name="EGW" />

===Propulsion systems===
Built for speed, the ''Bellator'' sacrificed armaments to gain higher velocities than its ''Mandator''-class predecessors. This philosophy separated it from its conceptual cousin, the [[Mandator III-class dreadnought|''Mandator III''-class dreadnought]], which was built to be larger and more heavily armed than the previous models of the series.<ref name="JFT" />

The ''Bellator''-class had two reactors that protruded underneath the superstructure with armored bulges. It was propelled by ten large thrusters and four smaller ones.<ref name="EGW" />

===Bridge tower===
The class was marked with a ridge-structure in front of its command tower. The tower itself was similar to the towers on a number of other Imperial warships, like the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] and the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]].

==History==
===Design lineage===
[[File:Imperial-Star-Cruiser.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A ''Bellator''-class dreadnought orbiting [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] with a ''Procursator''-class Star Destroyer escort.]]
The ''Bellator''-class dreadnought was a design based on the ''Mandator''- and ''Mandator II''-classes. It diverged from its predecessors by being shorter and faster and the design was referred to in the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] as a "fast dreadnought".<ref name="JFT" />

===Service history===
During the class's service period, several ''Bellator''-class dreadnoughts were known to have docked at [[Naval Station Validusia/Legends|Naval Station ''Validusia'']] for refueling and maintenance alongside other heavy warships.<ref name="EGW" /> In addition, ships of both this class and that of its cousin, the ''Mandator''-class, often flanked the [[Assertor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Assertor''-class Star Dreadnought]] in fleet formations during the Galactic Civil War since prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], largely due to that ship's role as a sector command and control ship.<ref name="Lead by Example">''[[Lead by Example]]''</ref>

[[File:Naval_Station_Validusia.jpg|thumb|left|170px|Several ''Bellator''-class ships docked at [[Naval Station Validusia/Legends|Naval Station ''Validusia'']].]]

[[File:HeroesofYavinNRfleet.jpg|thumb|150px|The [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] fly in formation with several [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]], including a ''Bellator''.]]
At some point prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]] of [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] observed several ''Bellator''s that were part of a fleet gathering.<ref name="EGW" /> The fleet included several battlecruisers and Star Destroyers and displayed maneuvers by entire squadrons of [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]] fighters.<ref name="EGW" /> After the [[Arms Race]] campaign of the Galactic Civil War,<ref name="Arms Race timeframe">Three [[TIE/ad starfighter]]s were seen flying in formation during the refilling procedure, which indicates that it took place after the [[Arms Race]] campaign shown in [[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']], due to the TIE/ad starfighter entering the Imperial Navy after the events of that campaign.</ref> at least one ''Bellator''-class was involved in a fleet exercise that involved an [[Altor-class replenishment ship|''Altor''-class replenishment ship]] refueling multiple large military vessels, including an ''Assertor''-class Star Dreadnought and an [[Allegiance-class battlecruiser|''Allegiance''-class battlecruiser]] simultaneously.<ref name="EGW" /> Its presence during this time presumably had to do with the presence of the former vessel.<ref name="Lead by Example" />

===Post-Endor===
At least one ''Bellator''-class dreadnought appeared to be in service with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the Thrawn Crisis, flying in formation alongside a fleet of ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers that were adorned with the New Republic logo, as well as a [[Procursator-class Star Destroyer|''Procursator''-class Star Destroyer]]. The fleet was joined by the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]], flying in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="EGW" />

During [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] capture and transport to [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], a ''Bellator''-class vessel was present during a [[Byss Defense Fleet|fleet]] maneuver of various [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] around the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="DE">[[Dark Empire 2|''Dark Empire'' 2]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The design just looked so ''mean'' when I first saw it, like some very angry bear prowling the forest. The idea was a fast battleship/battlecruiser, built to hunt destroyers and worry dreadnoughts. I kept the dagger shape narrow and long, since it gave a real sense of menacing speed to the whole ship.|Ansel Hsiao|<ref name="I134" />}}
[[File:Port2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Ansel Hsiao's model.]]
This design originated as a background vessel in [[Dark Empire 2|''Dark Empire'' 2]], drawn by [[Cam Kennedy]]. It was later remade as a detailed 3D [[fanon]] vessel by [[Ansel Hsiao]] and displayed on his 3D modelling site.<ref name="I134" /> The background ship had previously been cataloged by [[Curtis Saxton]] as the "anonymous star cruiser #5" on his technical [[Curtis Saxton|fansite]].<ref name="Fractalsponge comment1">{{WebCite|url=http://bbs.stardestroyer.net/viewtopic.php?f=46&t=124353&start=15|text=Something big - Page 1|work=stardestroyer.net|archivedate=20200923232030}}</ref>

When Hsiao first saw the design in ''Dark Empire'', he compared its appearance to a very angry bear prowling the forest. He envisioned it as a fast battleship/battlecruiser designed to hunt destroyers and even worry dreadnoughts. For his 3D work, he kept the dagger-shaped hull of the ship narrow and long in order to invoke a real sense of menacing speed throughout the whole ship.<ref name="I134" /> The class-name chosen by Hsiao is the Latin word for "warrior".<ref name="UNDLDAGA">{{WebCite|url=http://www.archives.nd.edu/cgi-bin/lookup.pl?stem=bella&ending=tor|text=bella tor|work=Latin Dictionary and Grammar Aid|archivedate=20210423120312}}</ref>
Approached by [[Lucasfilm]] Licensing to provide artwork for ''The Essential Guide to Warfare'', Hsiao submitted his own designs in addition to new models, along with their names. The names were recorded in LFL's [[Holocron continuity database]].<ref name="Fractalsponge comment2">{{WebCite|url=http://bbs.stardestroyer.net/viewtopic.php?f=46&t=124353&start=1576|text=Something big - Page 64|work=stardestroyer.net|archivedate=20200526055130}}</ref><ref name="JFT" /> He also indicated that, if one compares the ''Star Wars'' ships to 20th century naval ships, the ''Bellator''{{'s}} closest equivalent was [[Wikipedia:HMS Vanguard (23)|HMS ''Vanguard'']].<ref name="Star Wars ships equivalent">{{WebCite|url=http://www.scifi-meshes.com/forums/showthread.php?2212-Star-Wars-projects-thread&p=561412&viewfull=1#post561412|text=www.scifi-meshes.com|nobackup=1}}</ref>

Creating the detailed model, Hsiao gave it the designation of "Star Battlecruiser".<ref name="AHg">{{WebCite|url=http://www.fractalsponge.net/gallery/Bellator/index.html|text=''Bellator''-class Star Battlecruiser|work=[https://fractalsponge.net fractalsponge.net]|archivedate=20200224095400}}</ref> It was later changed to "dreadnought" on the basis of the [[Anaxes War College System/Legends|Anaxes War College System]] classifications created by [[Jason Fry]] for his book, ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''. This was displayed in his seventh round of endnotes for the book.<ref name="JFT" /> A similar change was made with the [[Allegiance-class battlecruiser|''Allegiance''-class battlecruiser]], which on Hsiao's site was listed as a Heavy Star Destroyer.<ref name="AHg2">{{WebCite|url=http://www.fractalsponge.net/gallery/asd/index.html|text=''Allegiance''-class Heavy Star Destroyer|work=[https://fractalsponge.net fractalsponge.net]|archivedate=20200224093527}}</ref>

[[File:LaurelAndHardyJoinTheImperialNavy-EGW.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Captain Piett and Admiral Ozzel with two ''Bellator''-class dreadnoughts and other capital ships in the background.]]
In the book's endnotes, Jason gave several facts about the class as well as others done by Hsiao, which is now canon information. He also gave two accounts; in-universe and out-of-universe on the method behind the design of the ''Bellator''. The in-universe explanation, supplied in the History section, mentioned the divergence of the ''Mandator III'' and the ''Bellator'' from their predecessor designs. The out-of-universe explanation was that the ''Essential Guide to Warfare'' accidentially combined separate design specs for the art and text for the famous humpbacked ship in ''Dark Empire''.<ref name="JFT" />

In addition, according to Ansel Hsiao on Stardestroyer.net forums around the time ''Essential Guide to Warfare'' was released, both he and Jason Fry planned to make all the ''Mandator''-series, in addition to the ''Bellator''-class, humpbacked vessels similar to the one that appeared in ''Dark Empire'', although nothing of the sort made it into the final cut by the time of its release.<ref name="Mandator humpbacked">{{WebCite|url=http://bbs.stardestroyer.net/viewtopic.php?f=46&t=124353&start=1600|text=Something big - Page 65|work=stardestroyer.net|archivedate=20200326203436}}</ref> However, the intended humpbacked hulls of the ''Mandator''-series was nonetheless implied in Jason Fry's endnotes.<ref name="JFT" />

In addition to Hsiao's book illustrations, the ''Bellator'' can also be seen in two other paintings, both by [[Tommy Lee Edwards]]. The latter of which uses a picture from Hsiao's personal gallery as a background, where the ship appears as one of the vessels closest to the bridge in the foreground of the image (the rear being partially obscured by Admiral Ozzel's head), and another of the same class is seen a brief distance away facing the bridge.<ref name="Suvudulink">{{Suvudu|url=files/2012/04/Ozzel_Piett.jpg|text=Piett and Ozzel artwork}}</ref> The Hsiao picture in question was named "Strategic Reserve" by him.<ref name="FSG">{{WebCite|url=http://fractalsponge.net/gallery/images/Strategic%20Reserve.jpg|text=Strategic Reserve|work=[[Ansel Hsiao]]'s [https://fractalsponge.net official website]|archivedate=20260301060638}}</ref>

According to Hsiao in a comment on his website, the armament for the ship consists of 16 heavy dual turbolasers, 48 quad heavy turbolasers, 40 octuple barbette heavy turbolasers, 14 quad heavy ion cannons, 108 strategic missile tubes, 288 light missile tubes (grouped into launchers of 24 tubes), 142 medium quad turbolasers, and 1568 light quad weapons (ion cannons and laser cannons) However, this has not been published in any official sources.<ref name="Forum post">{{WebCite|url=http://bbs.stardestroyer.net/viewtopic.php?f=46&t=124353&start=200|text=Something big - Page 9|work=stardestroyer.net|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/TDws1}}</ref>

[[File:Bioware_bellator.png|thumb|left|200px|A portion of the ''Bellator'' model is used to illustrate an ancient Sith Star Destroyer.]]
In a promotional video made for [[BioWare]]'s online RPG, ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', one of the shots depict [[Odile Vaiken]] watching a Star Destroyer (implied to be the [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]]) being built. The details on the vessel correspond to a similar shot of the ''Bellator'' found on Ansel Hsiao's site, right down to gun placements and hull features.<ref name="TORT11">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 11: Rebirth of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 11: Rebirth of the Sith Empire}}</ref><ref name="FS75">{{WebCite|url=http://fractalsponge.net/gallery/Bellator/75.jpg|text=''Bellator'' artwork|work=[https://fractalsponge.net fractalsponge.net]|archivedate=20200317230232}}</ref>

Hsiao, commenting on this image, as well as an image of the ''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer he originally made a 3D model of, that was used as part of a ''Star Wars Galaxies'' trading card,<ref name="SWGTC">{{SWGTCG|set=The Price of Victory|cardname=Imperial Starfleet}}</ref> remarked that it amused him endlessly that LFL used his various 3D models in their own work (without his knowledge).<ref name="Comments on image resemblance>{{WebCite|url=http://www.scifi-meshes.com/forums/showthread.php?2212-Star-Wars-projects-thread/page292|text=3D Star Wars projects thread - Page 292|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/bma8h|nolive=1}}</ref>
